# VisuStock

> VisuStock is a premium digital marketplace for stock assets and creative resources — high-quality photos, videos, audio tracks, ebooks and AI-generated content sold by independent creators worldwide. Buyers get instant, properly licensed downloads. Creators earn fair revenue with transparent payouts.

VisuStock combines a curated stock library, a creator-driven marketplace, and built-in AI tools (image generation, upscaling, background removal, video/audio editing) in a single platform. Every asset is reviewed for quality, originality and licensing compliance.

## What VisuStock Offers

- **Stock photos**: Royalty-free and premium photography for marketing, editorial, social media and print.
- **Stock videos**: 4K and HD footage, b-roll, motion backgrounds and cinematic clips.
- **Audio & music**: Background music, sound effects, loops and podcast-ready tracks.
- **Ebooks & digital downloads**: Guides, templates, design assets and educational content.
- **AI-generated assets**: Curated AI imagery with clear provenance labeling.
- **AI creative tools**: Image generation, image/video upscaling, background removal, face enhancement, text-to-speech, video reframing and audio duration adjustment.

## Who It's For

- **Buyers**: Marketers, agencies, video editors, social media managers, content creators, podcasters, publishers and small businesses needing licensed creative assets fast.
- **Sellers / Creators**: Photographers, videographers, musicians, illustrators, designers and AI artists looking to monetize their work with fair commission rates.

## Why Choose VisuStock

- Instant downloads after purchase
- Clear, simple licensing (commercial-ready)
- Curated quality — every submission is reviewed
- AI-content transparency and integrity scanning
- Fair creator revenue share with PayPal payouts
- Flexible pricing: pay-per-asset, credit packs and subscriptions
- Built-in AI tools that work alongside the marketplace

## Trust & Safety

- Every uploaded asset is moderated before going live.
- AI-detection and integrity scanning prevent fraudulent or stolen content.
- Secure, time-limited download URLs protect buyers and creators.
- Transparent dispute and reporting workflow.
- GDPR-compliant data handling.

## How to Buy

1. Browse the marketplace or search by keyword, category or theme.
2. Preview watermarked content before purchase.
3. Buy a single asset, use credits, or subscribe for ongoing access.
4. Download the original, high-resolution, watermark-free file instantly.

## How to Sell

1. Sign up at [Become a Seller](https://visustock.com/become-seller).
2. Submit your portfolio for review.
3. Upload assets with titles, descriptions and tags (AI-assisted).
4. Earn a transparent revenue share, paid via PayPal.
